_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Udlala umdlalo weKlondike Solitaire. Injongo yakho kukususa zonke ikhadi ukuyisa kwikhadi zesiseko.

Imithetho yeMdlalo:
- Ikhadi zesiseko (F1-F4): Yakha ukusuka kwiAce ukuya kwiKing ngokwesuti
- Ikhadi zetafula (T1-T7): Yakha ukusuka phezulu ukuya phantsi ngokwembala ehlukanayo (ebomvu phezu kwesikhundla esikhundla phezu kwesikhundla ebomvu)
- Isitokisi: Thatha ikhadi ukuyisa kwikhadi ezikhundleni
- Ikhadi ezikhundleni (W): Ikhadi eliphezulu elikhoyo ukudlala

Imiyalelo:
- 'draw' - Thatha ikhadi esitokisini ukuyisa kwikhadi ezikhundleni
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Susa ikhadi phakathi kwekhadi
  Iminzeko: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. isibalo sinaweza naku 'all', esizama ukususa zonke ikhadi eziphakanyisiweyo.
- 'forfeit' - Qeda umdlalo ngokukhawuleza ukulocka iskoru yakho yamanje
- Amagama ekhadi: W (ikhadi ezikhundleni), F1-F4 (ikhadi zesiseko), T1-T7 (ikhadi zetafula)

Ungakwazi ukwenza izenzo ezininzi ngexesha elinye ngokuzihambanisa ngokwethutyana:
  Umzeko: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Izikhothane kuphela ezinaweza ukubekwa phezu kwekhadi zetafula ezikhaliweyo.
Izenzo zikwenziwa ngokulandelelana - ukuba eyodwa iqhube, izenzo ezisele zisatyhiniwe.
Sebenzisa 'forfeit' ukuba ukholelwa ukuba umdlalo awunakwenziwa ukunqoba.
